mapper.sql: id, venue_id, title, content, color, tags, author_id, linked_asset_id, sort_order, pinned, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venue_smart_notes (id, venue_id, title, content, color, tags, author_id, linked_asset_id, sort_order, pinned) VALUES (#{id}, #{venueId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{color}, #{tags, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{authorId}, #{linkedAssetId}, #{sortOrder}, #{pinned})
mapper.update: UPDATE venue_smart_notes SET tags = #{tags, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.StringArrayTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM venue_smart_notes WHERE venue_id = #{venueId}
